ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Crozier needs access to your local network to discover and connect to nearby desktop daemons.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Crozier uses the camera to scan the QR code shown by the desktop daemon when pairing a device.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Crozier accesses your photo library only when you choose a QR code image to pair with a nearby desktop daemon.
